propositions: The file-backed bridge-status handler and purge-bridge command implementations were removed in change 1517 and must remain absent.
A hidden compatibility alias routes legacy rebar bridge-status invocations to the canonical durable bridge status operation without resurrecting the deleted file-backed implementation.
The durable bridge_status schema, Python facade, MCP tool/model, and generator registries must remain intact to support surviving consumers.
Behavioral contract tests must verify both retired commands are unknown and absent from top-level help, and that no references persist in shipped source and active documentation.
Read warnings currently pointing to the retired bridge-status command must be replaced with neutral bridge-alert guidance.
The schema registry, CLI reference, output-schemas documentation, and CHANGELOG must be updated to reflect both command retirements.
